== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 2 cups apple [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]], heated
* 4 sprigs fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 10 sprigs fresh [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], finely chopped
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] ice
* 4 thick-cut [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] rib chops
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]], cracked
* 1 tablespoon smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tablespoon ancho [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile]] powder

== Procedure ==
#Combine honey, salt, vinegar, rosemary, thyme, cayenne pepper, and minced garlic in a plastic zip-top bag. Add ice, and shake the bag until ice is mostly melted and mixture has cooled down.
#Insert pork chops into the bag, and refrigerate for 1–2 hours.
#Combine cracked peppercorns, paprika, and chili powder.
#Take the pork out of the mixture and pat dry with [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]]. Discard remaining marinade.
#Rub pepper mixture on both sides of each pork chop.
#Quickly grease a high-heat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] with a flame-resistant towel soaked in oil and tied with twine.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] pork chops, covered, 2 minutes. Rotate 90 degrees, and cook for another 2 minutes. Flip and repeat this process on the other side.
#Move to a plate and let rest, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Serve warm.
